wins.label: Strong Organic Base Fee Growth
wins.evidence: We delivered 6% or higher organic base fee growth in each quarter of 2025. We finished the year with 2 consecutive quarters of double-digit organic base fee growth, including 12% in the fourth quarter.

wins.label: Record Net Inflows
wins.evidence: Clients awarded us nearly $700 billion in net new assets in 2025.

wins.label: Dividend Increase and Share Repurchases
wins.evidence: We increased our 2026 dividend per share by 10% and increased planned share repurchases to $1.8 billion.

wins.label: Margin Expansion
wins.evidence: Our 45% operating margin in the fourth quarter was up 30 basis points year-over-year.

wins.label: Technology and Data Growth
wins.evidence: We delivered 16% technology ACV expansion in 2025.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: We mentioned that markets were in turmoil back in April, which could impact future performance.

risks.label: Noncash Mark-to-Market Loss
risks.evidence: Nonoperating results for the quarter included $106 million of net investment losses, primarily due to a noncash mark-to-market loss linked to our minority investment in Circle.

risks.label: Performance Fee Impact
risks.evidence: Our fourth quarter as-adjusted operating margin of 45% was down 50 basis points year-over-year, reflecting the impact of performance fees and related compensation.

risks.label: Tax Rate Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The actual effective tax rate may differ because of nonrecurring or discrete items or potential changes in tax legislation.

risks.label: Private Credit Risks
risks.evidence: Default rates in the broader leveraged loan market are averaging slightly below the long-term average of 3%, but there is a risk of rising defaults in the future.

wins.label: Strong Net Asset Growth
wins.evidence: Clients awarded BlackRock nearly $700 billion in net new assets in 2025, including $342 billion in the fourth quarter.

wins.label: Record Base Fee Organic Growth
wins.evidence: 12% organic base fee growth in the fourth quarter, representing $1.5 billion of net new base fees.

wins.label: High Fee Yields on New Assets
wins.evidence: Fee yields on new asset flows this year are 6 to 7x higher than they were in 2023.

wins.label: Margin Expansion Potential
wins.evidence: Continued growth in private markets and scaled businesses like ETFs and systematic equities will drive margin expansion.

wins.label: Integrated Platform Synergies
wins.evidence: The combined strength of BlackRock, GIP, HPS and Preqin creates significant opportunities for cross-selling and enhanced services.

risks.label: Credit Risk in Private Credit
risks.evidence: Potential for increased defaults in smaller companies and a return to historical average default rates in the leveraged loan market.

risks.label: Competition in Private Markets
risks.evidence: Increased competition for private market assets, particularly from other institutional investors.

risks.label: Interest Rate Sensitivity
risks.evidence: The impact of falling interest rates on money market yields and investor demand for fixed income strategies.

risks.label: Regulatory Changes
risks.evidence: Potential changes in regulations related to private markets, such as the 401(k) rule changes.

risks.label: Macroeconomic Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The potential impact of a global economic slowdown on asset flows and investment performance.
